-- Project events not yet in a work session, and the sessions they can join.
SELECT json_build_object(
  'events', COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('event_id', event_id, 'project_root', project_root,
                                      'project_name', project_name, 'ts', ts) ORDER BY ts)
    FROM (SELECT event_id, project_root, project_name, ts
          FROM activity_events
          WHERE session_id IS NULL AND project_root IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY ts LIMIT 5000) e
  ), '[]'::json),
  'sessions', COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('session_id', session_id, 'project_root', project_root,
                                      'project_name', project_name, 'started_at', started_at,
                                      'last_event_at', last_event_at))
    FROM work_sessions WHERE status IN ('open', 'processing')
  ), '[]'::json)
) AS data

-- $1 plan: { sessions: [...], assignments: [{ event_id, session_id }] }
WITH plan AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO work_sessions (session_id, project_root, project_name, started_at, last_event_at)
  SELECT s.session_id, s.project_root, s.project_name, s.started_at, s.last_event_at
  FROM plan, jsonb_to_recordset(plan.p -> 'sessions') AS s(
    session_id text, project_root text, project_name text,
    started_at timestamptz, last_event_at timestamptz)
  ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET
    started_at = LEAST(work_sessions.started_at, EXCLUDED.started_at),
    last_event_at = GREATEST(work_sessions.last_event_at, EXCLUDED.last_event_at),
    project_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.project_name, work_sessions.project_name),
    status = CASE WHEN work_sessions.status = 'closed' THEN 'open' ELSE work_sessions.status END
  RETURNING session_id
),
assigned AS (
  UPDATE activity_events e SET session_id = a.session_id
  FROM plan, jsonb_to_recordset(plan.p -> 'assignments') AS a(event_id text, session_id text)
  WHERE e.event_id = a.event_id AND e.session_id IS NULL
  RETURNING e.event_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted)::int AS sessions,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM assigned)::int AS events

-- $1 idleMinutes, $2 interimMinutes, $3 rawRetentionDays
-- Claims sessions to summarise: ended (idle) ones, and long-running ones
-- whose last summary is older than interimMinutes. Also applies retention.
WITH cleanup_events AS (
  DELETE FROM activity_events
  WHERE (processed_at IS NOT NULL AND processed_at < now() - make_interval(days => $3::int))
     OR (project_root IS NULL AND ts < now() - make_interval(days => $3::int))
  RETURNING 1
),
cleanup_sessions AS (
  DELETE FROM work_sessions
  WHERE status = 'closed' AND last_event_at < now() - interval '7 days'
  RETURNING 1
),
recovered AS (
  UPDATE work_sessions SET status = 'open'
  WHERE status = 'processing' AND claimed_at < now() - interval '30 minutes'
  RETURNING session_id
),
claimed AS (
  UPDATE work_sessions w
  SET status = 'processing', attempts = w.attempts + 1, claimed_at = now(),
      final = w.last_event_at < now() - make_interval(mins => $1::int)
  WHERE w.status = 'open'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_events e
                WHERE e.session_id = w.session_id AND e.processed_at IS NULL)
    AND (w.last_event_at < now() - make_interval(mins => $1::int)
         OR COALESCE(w.last_summarized_at, w.started_at) < now() - make_interval(mins => $2::int))
  RETURNING w.*
)
SELECT c.session_id, c.project_root, c.project_name, c.started_at, c.last_event_at,
       c.attempts, c.memory_id, c.final,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', e.event_id, 'ts', e.ts, 'source', e.source,
                                              'type', e.type, 'data', e.data) ORDER BY e.ts)
            FROM (SELECT * FROM activity_events
                  WHERE session_id = c.session_id AND processed_at IS NULL
                  ORDER BY ts LIMIT 3000) e), '[]'::json) AS events,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('ts', e.ts, 'type', e.type, 'data', e.data) ORDER BY e.ts)
            FROM activity_events e
            WHERE e.source = 'monitor'
              AND e.ts BETWEEN c.started_at - interval '15 minutes' AND c.last_event_at), '[]'::json) AS context,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('start', m.activity_start, 'website', m.website,
                                              'summary', m.summary) ORDER BY m.activity_start)
            FROM memories m
            WHERE m.website IS NOT NULL
              AND m.activity_start BETWEEN c.started_at - interval '30 minutes' AND c.last_event_at), '[]'::json) AS research,
  (SELECT json_build_object('id', m.id, 'title', m.page_title, 'summary', m.summary, 'status', m.status,
                            'files', m.files, 'progress', m.evidence ->> 'progress',
                            'blockers', m.evidence -> 'blockers', 'nextSteps', m.evidence -> 'nextSteps')
   FROM memories m WHERE m.id = c.memory_id) AS current_memory,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (
      SELECT m.id, m.page_title AS title, m.summary, m.status
      FROM memories m
      WHERE m.memory_type = 'coding_task' AND m.project_root = c.project_root
        AND m.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'
        AND m.id IS DISTINCT FROM c.memory_id
      ORDER BY COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) DESC
      LIMIT 5) t), '[]'::json) AS open_tasks
FROM claimed c
ORDER BY c.started_at

-- $1 session_id, $2 action (store | discard | retry | drop), $3 final ('true'/'false'),
-- $4 memory (JSON), $5 processedUntil (events up to here were summarised)
-- Updates the task's existing memory instead of creating duplicates.
WITH m AS (SELECT $4::jsonb AS j),
target AS (
  SELECT memories.id FROM memories, m
  WHERE $2 = 'store' AND memories.memory_type = 'coding_task'
    AND memories.project_root = m.j ->> 'projectRoot'
    AND memories.id = NULLIF(m.j ->> 'targetMemoryId', '')::bigint
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE memories SET
    page_title = m.j ->> 'title',
    task_key = m.j ->> 'taskKey',
    summary = m.j ->> 'summary',
    details = m.j -> 'details',
    entities = m.j -> 'entities',
    status = m.j ->> 'status',
    files = (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT f), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
               SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(memories.files, '[]'::jsonb)) AS f
               UNION SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(m.j -> 'files')) x),
    evidence = m.j -> 'evidence',
    pending_task = NULLIF(m.j ->> 'pendingTask', ''),
    confidence = (m.j ->> 'confidence')::real,
    importance = (m.j ->> 'importance')::real,
    related_memory_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(m.j ->> 'relatedMemoryId', '')::bigint, memories.related_memory_id),
    activity_start = LEAST(memories.activity_start, (m.j ->> 'startedAt')::timestamptz),
    activity_end = GREATEST(memories.activity_end, (m.j ->> 'endedAt')::timestamptz),
    session_id = m.j ->> 'sessionId',
    updated_at = now()
  FROM m
  WHERE memories.id IN (SELECT id FROM target)
  RETURNING memories.id
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO memories (activity_start, activity_end, website, page_title, memory_type, summary,
                        details, entities, pending_task, importance, project, project_root,
                        task_key, session_id, activity_type, status, files, evidence,
                        confidence, related_memory_id, updated_at)
  SELECT (j ->> 'startedAt')::timestamptz, (j ->> 'endedAt')::timestamptz, NULL, j ->> 'title',
         'coding_task', j ->> 'summary', j -> 'details', j -> 'entities',
         NULLIF(j ->> 'pendingTask', ''), (j ->> 'importance')::real, j ->> 'projectName',
         j ->> 'projectRoot', j ->> 'taskKey', j ->> 'sessionId', 'coding', j ->> 'status',
         j -> 'files', j -> 'evidence', (j ->> 'confidence')::real,
         NULLIF(j ->> 'relatedMemoryId', '')::bigint, now()
  FROM m
  WHERE $2 = 'store' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target)
  RETURNING id
),
memory AS (SELECT id FROM updated UNION ALL SELECT id FROM inserted),
done_events AS (
  UPDATE activity_events SET processed_at = now()
  WHERE session_id = $1 AND processed_at IS NULL AND ts <= $5::timestamptz
    AND $2 IN ('store', 'discard', 'drop')
  RETURNING 1
),
session AS (
  UPDATE work_sessions SET
    status = CASE
      WHEN $2 = 'retry' THEN 'open'
      WHEN $3 = 'true' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM activity_events e
        WHERE e.session_id = $1 AND e.processed_at IS NULL AND e.ts > $5::timestamptz
      ) THEN 'closed'
      ELSE 'open' END,
    memory_id = COALESCE((SELECT id FROM memory LIMIT 1), memory_id),
    last_summarized_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'retry' THEN last_summarized_at ELSE now() END,
    attempts = CASE WHEN $2 = 'retry' THEN attempts ELSE 0 END
  WHERE session_id = $1
  RETURNING status
)
SELECT $1 AS session_id, $2 AS action, (SELECT id FROM memory LIMIT 1) AS memory_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM done_events)::int AS events_processed,
       (SELECT status FROM session) AS session_status
